headline: Bournemouth favourites against Milan after first league win
summary: Bournemouth are the market's favourites for Thursday's Europa League visit of AC Milan, and the form explains it. Their first league win of the season, at home to Sunderland, came with 4.4 expected goals. Milan arrive without Goncalo Ramos and Samuel Chukwueze, both ruled out, and their win chance has eased from 29.1% to 26.6%. Still, Milan won 4-0 at Salzburg in this competition, so they are not harmless away. Bournemouth are 47.7% to win, the average of 10 bookmakers with the margin removed; the goal line is 2.75, with over close to even.
read: Bournemouth host Milan as the market's favourites at 47.7%, built on two straight home wins to nil — the latest a 4.4-xG display against Sunderland — and a perfect six points from two Europa League games. Milan have three points and are 16th after a 0-2 home defeat to Benfica, and they come into this without forwards Goncalo Ramos and Samuel Chukwueze, with their win chance easing from 29.1% to 26.6% in the last day.

facts.fact: Bournemouth are the market's favourites at 47.7% to win — Milan's win chance is less than half of that.
facts.meaning: The home side, not the six-time European champions, is the team the market expects to win at the Vitality.

facts.fact: AC Milan have lost Goncalo Ramos (calf discomfort in training) and Samuel Chukwueze (left hip) and both are ruled out of the Bournemouth match.
facts.meaning: Milan travel with two attacking options removed from an already rotated forward line.

facts.fact: Bournemouth's first league win of the season, at home to Sunderland, came with 4.4 xG and just 0.13 against.
facts.meaning: They are creating chances at a rate that backs up the market making them favourites here.

facts.fact: Bournemouth have six points from their first two Europa League games and sit fifth of 36; Milan are 16th with three.
facts.meaning: A perfect European start against a side that has already dropped a home game in this competition.

facts.fact: Milan won 4-0 away at Red Bull Salzburg in their second Europa League game.
facts.meaning: Their best European display came on the road — they are not harmless as the underdog.

facts.fact: Bournemouth are without midfielder Alex Scott, who has played 536 minutes this season with a goal, an assist and a 7.3 rating, and a two-week absence has been reported.
facts.meaning: A regular starter is missing from the home midfield for the visit of Milan.

facts.fact: The market's goal line sits at 2.75, with over priced at 49.6% — essentially a coin flip.
facts.meaning: Around three goals is the expectation: an open game, but not a shootout.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line moved from -0.32 to -0.43 goals in the last day.

sources.fact: Bournemouth boss Marco Rose has described the AC Milan tie as a "huge game" against six-time Champions League winners and Italian giants.
Junior Kroupi has returned to Bournemouth training but is ruled out of the AC Milan match, according to Bournemouth Echo.

Marco Rose gave an update on Junior Kroupi in his Bournemouth injury news ahead of the AC Milan clash, with a two-week timeframe expected for Scott to miss the Milan, Man United, Bournemouth and Leeds games.
Bournemouth beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Vitality Stadium to secure their first league win of the season and move out of the relegation zone.
Bournemouth registered 29 shots and an xG of 4.32 in their win over Sunderland, and now head into the Milan visit off a landmark victory.
Goalkeeper Di Gregorio, on loan from Juventus, has made just one Carabao Cup appearance since arriving, with Petrovic remaining Marco Rose's starter, per Gazzetta.
Goncalo Ramos has been ruled out of the Bournemouth match after calf discomfort in training, with further medical tests expected, per Sky Italia.
Samuel Chukwueze has also missed training because of a problem with his left hip and is ruled out of the Bournemouth clash.
